biography: Mike Wallace didn't grow up around racetracks. He grew up on the dirt bike trails of rural Mississippi, tearing through the woods with a reckless abandon that both thrilled and terrified his parents. His transition to four wheels came unexpectedly. At 16, while visiting an uncle in Charlotte, he stumbled into a small, local stock car race. The roar of the engines, the smell of burning rubber, the sheer ferocity of the competition – it hooked him instantly. He spent the next year working odd jobs, saving every penny to buy a beat-up Stock USA Gen2 car. His first race was a disaster, ending with him spinning into the infield on lap two, but the fire was lit. Word of his aggressive, almost kamikaze driving style began to spread. He's now a rising star in the Stock USA Gen2 circuit, known for his daring overtakes and refusal to back down.
drivingStyle: Wallace's driving style is all about controlled aggression. He's known for late-braking maneuvers and daring dives into corners that often leave other drivers shaking their heads. Tire management isn't exactly his forte; he prefers to push the car to its absolute limit, sacrificing long-run pace for the thrill of immediate performance. Under pressure, he tends to become even more aggressive, either cracking under the strain or pulling off a miraculous victory.
rivalries: Jake "The Professor" Peterson - Peterson represents the old guard of Stock USA, known for his calculated precision. Wallace sees him as everything he isn't, and is determined to prove that raw talent can beat experience.

Ava "The Hurricane" Hernandez - Hernandez is another young gun, but her consistent performance and polished image contrast sharply with Wallace's wild style. Their clashes on and off the track are legendary.
Marcus "The Mechanic" Bellweather - Their rivalry started when Bellweather accused Wallace of intentionally wrecking him during a crucial race. Wallace's unapologetic attitude only fueled the fire.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of worn-out racing gloves, no matter the weather.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track right before getting into the car to pump himself up.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small, crude picture of a shark on the steering wheel with a marker.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Stock USA Gen2 Championship race at Daytona after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty. He made a last-lap pass that will be talked about for years.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the championship race the previous season, costing him the title by a single point.
